Specification: This specification models a small PlusCal algorithm with one global variable x and a procedure Foo that increments x and returns to the caller. The main control repeatedly executes label A, calls Foo, jumps to label C, decrements x, and then loops back to A; there is also a translated label Lbl_2 corresponding to unreachable code after the goto. The generated TLA+ translation introduces control variable pc and a call stack variable stack, defines the initial state and step actions, and specifies behavior with Init /\ [][Next]_vars. It also includes a termination property asserting eventual reachability of pc = "Done", although the loop structure makes the system nonterminating except for the explicit Terminating stuttering action on Done.
